:::{#hero-heading style="font-size: 1.1em;"}
Welcome to the website of the **NICLA** group (**N**europsychology: **I**nnovative concepts for **C**linical **A**ssessment and rehabilitation)

## Who we are
We are group of people (from Academia and Healthcare), who meet informally to discuss and share ideas about neuropsychology, with a focus on clinical assessment and rehabilitation. We are mostly (but not only) based in Padova, Italy.

## How to join 
Send an e-mail to giulia.sebastianutti@phd.unipd.it and ask to join our meetings

## Our meetings
Our meetings are held every 2-3 months, and are open to anyone interested in neuropsychology, clinical assessment, and rehabilitation. They are usually held in Padova, at the spaces of University of Padova.
